title: DEBT33: An answered queue entry can never resurface, even when it is wrong
note: `store/queues.py:Queue.upsert` refuses to re-queue a position that carries `cleared_by_human` (D167: an answer outlives the question that produced it) and has no exception for an answer later shown wrong. A card answered once is later contradicted by a live catalogue lookup or by its own SKU's other copies. It cannot reach a person through the standing queue again. When D239 counted the archive sweep's refusals against the real store, 16 entries were `cleared_by_human` (13 with an `answered` event, 3 for `no_catalog_row` with no logged event). The 13 answers were checked against their photos and the catalog, and were right. The sweep did not keep its refusal text, so the cause of those refusals is unknown. A later full sweep over the real store answered all 13 with no repair. The gap itself stands for a genuinely wrong answer: it cannot reach a person through the review queue. A SKU number contradiction has the same shape and no queue to land in.
